name: Onepapa ~Onegai PaPa!~
source:
The main character is a 27-year-old writer who lives alone after his parents died in a plane crash. One day a girl suddenly arrives asking to let her stay for the spring break. She pretends to be his daughter in public, and each day brings new emotions. What will the approaching summer bring?

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
